focus.name: Focus
focus.body:
The synergistic blend of sage, peppermint and lavender is traditionally used to support concentration, memory and the process of studying. This blend is recommended during periods of intense mental provocation, when your brain is taking in large amounts of information without much time to rest and process, for example, when it feels difficult to concentrate, especially during deadlines or exams. Inhaling this blend may support a harmonious, focused state of mind. It is your perfect study-mate for creating projects, preparing for exams, meeting deadlines at work, and generally combating all forms of distraction that impede productivity.

Ritual · how to use

Add 8-10 drops into your diffuser while studying, working or creating projects. Add 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent 7 times deeply and rhythmically when loosing focus. After 3 weeks of continuous use keep 1 week break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Copaifera officinalis (copaiba balm), Mentha piperita (peppermint), Salvia officinalis (sage), Lavandula angustifolia (English lavender), Rosmarinus officinalis ct. cineole (rosemary) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

I've taken a lot of exams, when I'm getting tired or my thoughts are blocked, I have a sniff straight from the vial and my mind and thoughts get stabilized immediately. Basically your best friend in any situation where Focus is required.

★★★★★
“I recently started a Masters study alongside my work, and with everything going on I felt like I was easily losing focus and thinking of too many things at once. I don't like drinking coffee, so this is a fantastic alternative to energise me and keep me focused on my studies and work. I like to rub it in my palms and inhale a few times as suggested, but sometimes I also just smell from the bottle and it already makes me feel more awake and focused. Thank you Peter for this magical blend!”
Aisha
Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of epilepsy handle with care. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. A skin test is recommended prior to use. Do not use long term and in large quantities.

homecoming.name: Homecoming
homecoming.body:
Do you sometimes feel lost in a situation, incapable of making decisions? Do you sometimes feel helpless, incapable of accessing your inner source? The incredibly complex Homecoming blend contains both vetiver to help you rediscover your inner strength and Atlas cedar to guide you back to your inner peace. Other ingredients kickstart and clear stagnant internal processes. The incorporation of sage additionally awakens your intuition, fostering the ability to see with greater clarity during foggy times.

When I designed the recipe of the Homecoming blend, an especially personal one for me, one question was stirring in my mind: if I could travel back in time, what kind of aromatherapy blend would I have given to my own lost, sad, puzzled self, so I could have seen in myself at the time and in the world at large the embedded wonders that they truly contain?

Ritual · how to use

Mornings & evenings apply 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent slowly, deeply and rhythmically 7 times. After 5 days of use, keep 2 days of break.

Prior a challenging day, massage 3 drops into Manipura, the Solar plexus (the area above the belly button). It can help to remain strong-minded.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Ocimum basilicum (basil), Eucalyptus staigeriana (Brazilian eucalyptus), Pelargonium x asperum (rose geranium), Pogostemon cablin (patchouli) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

I recommend the olfactory (inhalation) therapy prior any type of meditation or mindfulness practice. Let this blend be a reminder to all: you are not the clouds, but the clear blue sky.

★★★★★
“Peter advised me to use this blend during a retreat last July, in the middle of the corona crisis, to get grounded, stay focused and come home to my own body and mind. I have used it ever since, first on the recommended basis (5 days use, 2 days break), but know I use it whenever I feel the need to feel more rooted, or just for the wonderful scent to accompany me during my day. I love it.”
Stephanie Simons

moonlight.name: Moonlight
moonlight.body:
Its specific components like mandarin, lavender, and marjoram are well known relaxants in aromatherapy.

According to traditional Chinese medicine, our 12 main organs recharge themselves in a specific order during sleep. The Chinese organ clock shows which organ is recovering at what time and how their energy levels accordingly change along the different meridians. Harmonious sleep is one of the best and most important ways to maintain health in your life.

Let the body and the mind dive deep into a truly healing, restorative sleep, with the power of every hidden star in the moonlight behind you.

Ritual · how to use

A) Add 8-10 drops into the diffusor in your bedroom before going to sleep. Let it vaporize the harmonizing blend during the whole night. Also add 1-1 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent slowly, deeply and rhythmically.

B) Make your own SPA at home. Dilute 10-12 drops in 3tbs of sea salt, add it to your warm bath (if you don't have a bathtub make a foot bath, use only 6-8 drops of essential oils). Lit some candles, put on meditation music, have a calming tea, breath deeply and slowly, and let your whole body sink into your aromatic bath.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Citrus reticulata zest (tangerine peel), Origanum majorana (marjoram), Lavandula x intermedia super (Lavandin), Lavandula angustifolia (English lavender), Chamaemelum nobile (Roman chamomile) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Surround yourself with lots of bedroom plants that will improve your sleep environment. Snake plant is the best for air purification, aloe vera will improve air quality, lavender will support deeper sleep and peace lily is the best for increasing humidity. Sleep like a baby in your own 'jungle'.

★★★★★
“I have a history of CFS and insomnia so I have always struggled with my sleeping patterns and tried countless approaches to establish a better rythmn and routine. Using this blend has enabled me to both fall asleep easier and to sleep more consistently through the night. It's also fantastic at easing nausea, soothing tension headaches and generally relieving anxiety. Would definitely recomment to anyone struggling with their sleep.”
Ansuya

flow.name: Flow
flow.body:
These warming herbs and spices not only loosen your muscles and relax your body, they impart the same benefits mentally as well. On the psychic level, this blend helps you to let go of the unnecessary, supports you to move on in your journey with renewed positivity and open-minded perspective.

According to folk traditions, lemon zest supports to shift a stuck mindset as a fresh breeze would support sailors to move forward; cardamom fires up the internal flow and cedarwood moves the Prana/Qi by supporting the lymphatic circulation. May this blend help you to jump free from the hamster wheel and help you look at challenging situations as opportunities rather than obstacles. Through this blend I offer you courage to open new doors and close old ones.

Ritual · how to use

A) For 28 days, mornings & evenings apply 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent slowly, deeply and rhythmically 7 times. After 28 days of use, keep 1 week of break then continue the same way if needed.

B) For supporting muscle relaxation after a long day spent with gardening or doing yoga: apply 5-10 drops -depending on the size of the area- into the muscle and massage it gently for a minute. After 5 days of use, keep 2 days of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Citrus limonum zest (lemon peel), Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Cupressus sempervirens (Mediterranean cypress), Cistus ladaniferus ct. pinéne (labdanum), Elettaria cardamomum (cardamom) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

I suggest you to step out of your comfort zone once a while. Try out new activities, new hobbies, go on an adventure, do something you never thought you would have the courage to do.

★★★★★
“Peter his blends are magical. You really smell/feel how he puts his love and wide knowledge in the blend. It felt like he made one just for me. Thank you!”
Samantha

Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. Possible photosensitivity: avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours. A skin test is recommended prior to use.

forest-bathing.name: Forest Bathing
forest-bathing.body:
I filled this exciting blend with the fresh, clean energy of the woods's greens, that switches on your solarplexus, the body's energy centre, and cleanses the heart chakra within your lungs.

I recommend using this blend during those anxious life situations when you need to take a deep breath, when your lung's energy is drained, when you feel you cannot breathe due to circumstances that are choking you. It can help you boost concentration levels and power on after exhausting ordeals with a more refreshed mind.

In cases of exhaustion, sadness, or simply feeling low on energy, the synergy of pine tree, black spruce, and eastern hemlock can energise your lungs and recharge your batteries. They can help you take a deep breath of inhalation, so you may release negativity and continue forward.

Ritual · how to use

A) Mornings as well as in situations when you feel shortness of breath, apply 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale it slowly and rhythmically 7 times.

B) In case of any heaviness in your chest rub 3-4 drops into your chest as well as into the upper back area together with 1tbs base oil (cold pressed coconut, sesame or apricot seed). After 5 days of use, keep 2 days of break and repeat the treatment if necessary.

C) For general boost, massage 5-7 drops all along your whole spine with some base oil as mentioned above. After 5 days of use keep 2 days of break.

D) Create a fresh and vibrant sanctuary and diffuse 8-10 drops daily in your home or office.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Pinus sylvestris (Scots pine), Eucalyptus radiata (eucalyptus), Picea mariana (black spruce), Melaleuca alternifolia (tea tree), Lavandula angustifolia (English lavender) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Go out and connect with Mother nature again. Hug trees, feel them, breath together with them. Let them slow you down and ground you fully. Walk around barefoot as much as you can, feel the earth beneath your feet. Spend as much time as you possibly can in nature.

Please read · cautions

Do not use in case of convulsive cough. For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. A skin test is recommended prior to use.

rainbow.name: Rainbow
rainbow.forline: the signature blend: 74 oils in one
rainbow.body:
The idea behind the creation of the Rainbow blend appeared at first only in the form of curiosity. I wanted to know the total number of individual essential oils, that are taking place in the blends of the Rainbow collection. I counted them carefully, and there are 74 essential oils in the Rainbow collection. During the counting I noticed, there are 21 essential oils, that commonly appear in many of the recipes and so they create the Rainbow blend. Togetherness is the vibration of the Rainbow collection.

Enjoy the freshness of the joyful citruses like lemon, sweet orange or bergamot. Let the ancient Damask rose, geranium and ylang-ylang flower up your soul and dive into your inner source with the guidance of vetiver, Atlas cedar and frankincense.

Enjoy the healing energy of a rainbow, let it strengthen your body, uplift your mind, encourage your heart & spice up your soul.

Ritual · how to use

A: For general boosting, balancing, brightening: mornings, when you awaken: apply 3 drops on your chest, in case of skin sensitivity, mix with a small amount of base oil (cold pressed cherry seed, coconut or apricot seed oil), massage the oil into the area. Than INHALE the scent from your hands 5 times deeply and rhythmically.

B: After lunch, support your metabolism, recharge the Solar plexus and balance the monkey-mind by massaging 4 drops into your belly. In case of skin sensitivity, mix with a small amount of base oil (cold pressed sesame seed, coconut or sunflower seed oil). Then INHALE the scent from your hands 5 times deeply and rhythmically.

C: Before going to sleep, ground, reconnect and release negative energy by massaging 3 drops into the sole of each foot. Then INHALE the scent from your hands 5 times deeply and rhythmically.

After 5 days of use, keep 2 days of break.

D: Olfactory therapy to support overall well-being: for 28 days, mornings & evenings, apply 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent slowly, deeply and rhythmically 7 times. After 28 days of use, keep 1 week of break and then continue the healing journey.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Citrus limonum zest (lemon peel), Citrus sinensis zest (sweet orange peel), Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Eucalyptus staigeriana (Brazilian eucalyptus), Zingiber officinalis (ginger root) … and other magical plants. The Rainbow blend brings together the 21 essential oils that recur most often across the 74 oils of the Rainbow collection.

Peter's personal tip

Create a harmonious and balanced environment at work or at home by adding 10 drops of Rainbow essence into your aroma-diffuser and enjoy the uplifting energy of these magical plants. Don't forget to open your window every hour for 5 minutes to have some fresh oxygen as well.

Please read · cautions

Do not use during pregnancy and nursing. Possible skin sensitivity when applied without base oil. Phototoxic: skin shouldn't be exposed to sunlight, solarium light and UV rays for at least 8 hours after application of the product. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. In case of epilepsy handle with care.

awakening-queen.name: Awakening Queen
awakening-queen.forline: feminine energy and the moon cycle
awakening-queen.body:
Awaken your Inner Goddess. In this blend I hid the most exquisite flowers of heaven's garden. These ingredients may awaken your femininity and also help with irritability, restlessness, agitation around your moon days, encouraging a smooth and effortless flow through your cycle. It contains oils like geranium, Damask rose, jasmine, and rose geranium that support female energies and bring your feminine creator force to the surface.

Ritual · how to use

A) To support the perfect flow and bring ease for the body and for the mind around the most challenging times of your cycle: in the 10 days prior the flow, apply 2-3 drops with a small amount of base oil (cold pressed apricot seed oil) on your lower abdomen, twice a day. Important that you inhale the scent deeply and rhythmically 7 times.

B) Supporting the natural flow of your feminine energy so the body can prepare for an other soul to arrive: massage 3-4 drops into your belly with a small amount of base oil (cold pressed apricot seed oil) every evening for 5 days and keep 2 days break and repeat. Important that you inhale the scent deeply and rhythmically 7 times. (Do not use the product when already pregnant!)

C) In case of irregular flow of your feminine energy: massage 3-4 drops into your lower abdomen with a small amount of base oil (cold pressed apricot seed oil) every evening for 21 days and keep 1 week break, repeat the treatment if necessary. Important that you inhale the scent deeply and rhythmically 7 times.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Rosa damascena (Damask rose flower), Jasminum officinalis (Jasmin flower), Pelargonium x asperum (rose geranium), Cananga odorata extra (ylang-ylang), Citrus sinensis zest (sweet orange peel) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Wear the bouquet of Gods in your hair. Massage 2 drops into your roots, and let your aura radiate beauty and love.

Please read · cautions

Do not use during pregnancy and nursing. In case of under-active thyroid function, epilepsy and on the first two days of menstruation handle with care. For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. A skin test is recommended prior to use. Possible photosensitivity: avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours.

sunrise.name: Sunrise
sunrise.body:
Our state of mind in the morning can determine the whole day. The way we wake up influences our energy level in the morning, and by extension our mood throughout the day.

This is why Ayurveda and Chinese medicine pay special attention to morning rituals. The Sunrise blend can seamlessly incorporated into often hasty morning routines.

Peppermint oil sobers and pacifies chaotic thoughts. The freshness of sunny lemon feels like a soft summer breeze for the soul and rosemary boosts energy levels by releasing entrenched tensions.

Start the day in a good mood, with refreshed head space, with energised body, and with gratitude in the heart, because life offers new possibilities with each morning.

Ritual · how to use

Apply 2 drops into your palm every morning directly after waking up. Rub your palms together and inhale the scent deeply, slowly and rhythmically 7 times.

In case of a difficult morning you can also either rub 5 drops into your spine or on Manipura (the Solar plexus, your energy centre above the belly button). If you have a sensitive skin, add a few drops of carrier oil (cold pressed coconut, sesame or sunflower seed).

In case of daytime weariness repeat the inhalation from your palms.

Always keep 1 week break after 3 weeks of continuous use.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Citrus limonum zest (lemon peel), Zingiber officinalis (ginger), Mentha piperita (peppermint), Citrus paradisii zest (grapefruit peel), Rosmarinus officinalis ct. camphre (rosemary) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Every morning is a new beginning and a new chance. According to Ayurveda waking up on the right side, opens the left nostril, called the Nadi Ida. It is said to activate the right hemisphere of the brain, that handles emotions and feminine energy, therefore brings more ease and peace into the morning. Stretch the whole body and a give a minute for yourself with the Sunrise blend, before you jump out of bed. Say a prayer and tell yourself that you are loved.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. Possible photosensitivity: avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours.

inner-king.name: Inner King
inner-king.body:
According to folk tradition, frankincense carries the highest vibration of male energies; sandalwood is believed to attract women in Indian culture; and the fiery, strengthening ginger may awaken your masculine energy as well as functions as an aphrodisiac. It is recommended in cases of physical or mental block and stagnant internal processes connected to masculinity (Yang energy) or the male genitalia. It may boost self-confidence, provide emotional stability and support healthy function of the genitalia.

Ritual · how to use

A) In case of infection, weakness, stagnation, pain or irregularity of the genitalia / urinary tract, contact your physician. You can support the natural flow of your life energy during your medical treatment (approved by your physician) with the blend as following; apply 3-5 drops on your lower abdomen, in case of skin sensitivity, together with a small amount of base oil (cold pressed sesame, sunflower seed or apricot seed oil) and massage it into the area. Apply mornings & evenings for 3 weeks and than keep 1 week break and repeat the treatment if necessary. Always inhale the rest of the scent from your palms 5 times deeply and rhythmically.

B) In case of weakness or stagnation resulting from psychic, emotional or stress related shock or in case of lack of self-confidence add 8-10 drops into your diffuser for the night + mornings apply 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent 7 times deeply and rhythmically + apply 3 drops on your Solar plexus (energy centre above the belly button) for 21 days and keep 1 week of break. Repeat the pocess if necessary.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Ammi visnaga (toothpick weed), Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Boswellia carterii (frankincense), Santalum album (sandalwood), Piper nigrum (black pepper) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Psychological stress can also affect all areas of our health, including our libido, achieving an erection or reaching an orgasm. Exercise is a great way to reduce stress and improve our health. Talking to our partner about our stress can also calm us down, while strengthening our relationship at the same time.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. A skin test is recommended prior to use. Possible photosensitivity: avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours.

space-maker.name: Space Maker
space-maker.body:
Create a healthy, crisp, fresh space full of light for all, while improve concentration. It is said in aromatherapy, that the ingredients of this antiseptic blend banish pathogens and negative energy. Perfect for common areas, such as workplaces or yoga studios, it works to keep the air purified.

Inhale this potent synergy of tea tree, Brazilian eucalyptus, and lemon for a peaceful mind and activated self-healing mechanism. Vaporise, breathe, and purify.

Ritual · how to use

Add 8-12 drops into the diffusor during daytime or nighttime.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Eucalyptus radiata (eucalyptus), Citrus limonum zest (lemon peel), Citrus sinensis zest (sweet orange peel), Melaleuca alternifolia (tea tree), Cinnamosma fragrans (saro) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

After a heated argument it can effectively balance the vibration in the space and can sooth the feeling of anger.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. Possible photosensitivity: avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours.

confidence-serum.name: Confidence Serum
confidence-serum.body:
Counterproductive patterns and informations become stuck in our energy bodies, not to mention the many labels placed upon us by society. It's no surprise our self-images often become distorted.

According to folk traditions, tarragon invigorates the soul, vetiver supports the sense of stability and cardamom boosts the inner strength. The synergy of these plants invigorate your instinct for life, they inspire self confidence in your decisions and strengthen you when the obstacles in every day life leave you feeling brittle and fragile. I created the confidence serum to help you in this chaotic world, to return your inner strength and empower your alignment with your inner values.

Ritual · how to use

For 28 days, mornings & evenings add 2 drops into your palms, rub them together then inhale the scent deeply 7 times. Add your positive affirmation or mantra (using your mother tongue) and repeat them 3x. Saying mantras, positive affirmations out loud every day for 28 days or repeating them occasionally 108 times can do miracles. Here is one for you to practice: "I believe in myself. I'm excited about my talents, gifts, and qualities." After 28 days of use, keep one week of break, then continue the same way until you finish the formula.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Artemisia dracunculus (tarragon), Vetiveria zizanoides (vetiver), Pinus ponderosa (Ponderosa pine), Elettaria cardamomum (cardamom), Ocimum basilicum (basil) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Find a new hobby that excites you and brings you joy and satisfaction or simply return to an old one that used to made you happy but life happened and it slowly faded away from you schedule.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. A skin test is recommended prior to use. Possible photosensitivity: avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours. In case of epilepsy handle with care.

chakra-essence.name: Chakra Essence
chakra-essence.forline: balance for the whole chakra system
chakra-essence.body:
The chakras are centres of energy within each human being which comprise our personality on all levels. They relate to specific physical organs, nervous plexuses, endocrine glands, emotional responses, mental patterns and psychic experiences within each of us, as well as, if we go deep enough, opening us up to spiritual insight. They function in each moment of our lives and, taken together, they encompass and embrace the entire spectrum of human experience.

Although the chakras are functioning in all of us, they tend to be blocked and imbalanced. Unblocking, harmonising and energising them brings profound changes in our understanding, perception and behaviour. This magical chakra essence is a blend that supports meditation, opens the meridians (the energy pathways of the body), and guides you to a deeper dimension of your own world. It abets the flawless circulation of prana, consequently allowing all organ systems ample chance for regeneration. This unique blend is also strongly grounding, linking you with the Divine source while helping you reconnect with yourself and your higher self. The conscious recognition and understanding of your energy-body can guide you to a better understanding of your symptoms, thereby allowing you to embark on a process of self-healing.

Ritual · how to use

A) Rub 2-3 drops on your Solar plexus (your energy centre above the belly button) and also add 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent 7 times, slowly and rhythmically prior any kind of meditation technique or before you are going to sleep. If you have a sensitive skin, add a few drops of carrier oil (cold pressed coconut, sesame or sunflower seed). After 5 days of use, keep 2 days of break.

B) For having more clarity when facing life-changing decisions, ask one of your loved ones to massage 7 drops all along your spine in spiral movements. In case of sensitive skin, use a small amount of base oil (cold pressed coconut or sunflower seed). After 5 days of use, keep 2 days of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Vetiveria zizanoides (vetiver), Boswellia carterii (frankincense), Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Citrus bergamia zest (bergamot peel), Cananga odorata extra (ylang-ylang) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Massage 2-2 drops onto the sole of your feet before sleeping. Your dreams may become more lucid and colourful. It is a nice way to awaken suppressed thoughts or traumas, so the mind can start dealing with them while you are sleeping. If you wake up from a dream, write down the key words and patterns of the dream on a paper, using only a soft light, so you can fall asleep again. Don't pay attention to the content of the dream or seek for meanings, just write it down, so you can let go of it.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. Possible photosensitivity: avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours.

speak-easy.name: Speak Easy
speak-easy.body:
We are all familiar with situations which leave us anxious, unable to swallow for the emotional lump in our throats or the feeling of swirling butterflies in the stomach. It is like, or may actually be the anxious state of mind that arises prior to exams, presentations, conferences, job interviews, meetings, or lectures which can often damage our performances leading to missed opportunities. Disappointments cement our anxiousness that may arise at similar events in the future. Studies show that bay laurel can release blockages in the mind, encouraging clear speech. Blue tansy may balance and open the throat chakra; and lavender can ease the entire body, and support children with inhibited communication, for example stutter.

This blend is designed to dissipate worry, create inner peace, help recall recently learnt knowledge, and open the clearest communication channels. Turn stage fright into a shining moment in the spotlight.

Ritual · how to use

Before exams, job interviews, conferences, meetings etc., create an opportunity for yourself to have a few minutes of silence. Add 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent 7 times deeply and rhythmically.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Laurus nobilis (Bay laurel), Pelargonium x asperum (rose geranium), Tanacetum annuum (blue tansy), Citrus bergamia zest (bergamot peel), Lavandula angustifolia (English lavender) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

If possible I would suggest you to do 5 minutes (12 rounds) of Nadhi Sodhana. Research shows that a regular practice of controlled breathing (Pranayama breathing techniques) can decrease the effects of stress on the body and increase overall physical and mental health.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use under age of 6. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. Possible photosensitivity: avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours. In case of convulsive cough handle with care.

defence.name: Defence
defence.body:
The combination of eucalyptus, camphor tree, and Niaouli may support the energy levels after a hectic day or during an exhausting period. This blend supports the defensive energy "Qi", awakens self-healing and boosts defences. In case of lack of energy, it helps to get back on our feet. Thanks to the expectorant qualities of some of the ingredients, it may expel cold and soothes irritation from chesty coughs and sore throats.

Ritual · how to use

A) For supporting your well-being or for energizing, ask one of your loved ones to massage 10 drops all along your spine. In case of skin sensitivity use a small amount of base oils that I mentioned above. Maximum 3 times a week and keep 1 week break after 3 weeks of use.

B) For daily hygiene and for energizing, diffuse 8-10 drops daily in your home. Also add 1 drop into your palm, rub it together and inhale the scent 5-7 times slowly and rhythmically at least once everyday.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Melaleuca alternifolia (tea tree), Eucalyptus radiata (eucalyptus), Cinnamosma fragrans (saro), Ocimum basilicum (basil), Melaleuca quinquenervia ct. cinéole (niaouli) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Support the defensive energy of the body. Dilute 10 drops in 4tbs of sea salt and add it to the warm bath and have a cleansing, relaxing aromatic bath. Once a week you can also rub 2-2 drops into the sole of your feet before sleeping to protecting you from the feet up.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. A skin test is recommended prior to use.

let-go.name: Let Go
let-go.body:
This blend with powerful depths supports the progress of mourning, of letting go, of processing. According to folk traditions, cypress helps process grief; Eastern hemlock connects you with your inner strength and with the celestial realm; and sweet orange, for all its heart-warming powers, brings sunlight to the most challenging of moments. I highly recommend to use this blend when one is about to take on a transformational process and needing to jump into the unknown.

"To be happy you must let go what's gone, be grateful for what remains, and look forward to what's coming next."

Ritual · how to use

Apply 1-1 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent deeply and rhythmically 5x mornings & evenings. You can also apply 2-2 drops on the inner area of your ankles before sleeping.

Use the formula for 28 days as mentioned above together with an affirmation ("I release what doesn't serve me anymore, I trust my inner guidance and I attract what's meant for me."), after 28 days of usage, keep 1 week of break then continue using the same way.

You can also add 5-10 drops into your aroma-diffuser to support your processes at home or during the night.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Cupressus sempervirens (Mediterranean cypress), Tsuga canadensis (Eastern hemlock), Chamaemelum nobile (Roman chamomile), Citrus sinensis zest (sweet orange peel), Lavandula angustifolia (English lavender) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

I believe it is important that you create some peace around you, while using the blend. Light a candle, create some silence, make some herbal tea and listen to some soothing frequency music. Emerge from your silence and chant, sing loudly your favourite song or mantra which helps you with the process of letting go. For example: "I release all blame and allow forgiveness to show me the way. To heal my past I live fully in the present."

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of epilepsy handle with care. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight.

mind-your-gut.name: Mind Your Gut
mind-your-gut.body:
Did you know that 95% of serotonin is produced by intestinal cells? Your gut is your second brain. This blend was created to aid indigestion, soothe an upset stomach and maintain the healthy functioning of your digestive system. Ginger, cardamom and peppermint have been used for centuries to ease motion sickness, nausea and flatulence, and to gently warm and support digestion after heavy meals.

Ritual · how to use

Apply 10 drops on your belly and massage it slowly in clockwise direction for a few minutes and inhale 5x the rest of the scent from your palms.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Citrus limonum zest (lemon peel), Coriandrum sativum (coriander), Origanum majorana (marjoram), Elettaria cardamomum (cardamom), Zingiber officinalis (ginger root) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Start your day by drinking a big glass of lukewarm water, it helps to flush out all toxins stored in your body overnight and boosts your metabolism.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. May cause photosensitivity: avoid sun and UV light for 8-12 hours after application.

solar-serum.name: Solar Serum
solar-serum.body:
This blend radiates the sunny, revitalizing energy of the Mediterranean citruses. Imagine you are sitting in a garden of a quaint Portuguese town, surrounded by lush orange trees. You are immersed in your favourite book, while exchanging smiles from your heart with the passersby. The warm, spring breeze gently caresses your skin. A joyful child offers you a sweet, mellifluous orange. As you bite on the fruit, the nectar of pure happiness and freedom runs through your soul.

The life-giving energies of the different citrus fruits, from sweet orange to bergamot to grapefruit, are carried within this blend. They are said to vibrate at the highest frequencies of happiness. Citruses will lift you up from darkness, lead you towards the light, and help you to reconnect with your inner child. Harnessing the vast power of sunlight, these ingredients can be extremely uplifting, said to be both preventing stress resulting from hectic lifestyle and helping to deal with everyday stresses.

Ritual · how to use

For 28 days, mornings & evenings apply 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent slowly, deeply and rhythmically 7 times. Or you can add 2 drops mornings and evening onto the Solar Plexus (Manipura chakra) the area just above the belly button (avoid sun and UV light for 8 hours), rub it in and inhale the scent from your hands deeply and rhythmically. After 28 days of use, keep 1 week of break and then continue the healing journey.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Citrus bergamia zest (bergamot peel), Citrus limonum zest (lemon peel), Citrus paradisii zest (grapefruit peel), Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Cupressus sempervirens (Mediterranean cypress) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Get as much sunlight as possible, but spend at least 5 minutes on the sun every day. During grey and dark winter-like days, add 10 drops into your aroma-diffuser and light up the space around you.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. Phototoxic: skin shouldn't be exposed to sunlight, solarium light and UV rays for at least 8-12 hours after application of the product.

shen-essence.name: Shen Essence
shen-essence.body:
In Traditional Chinese Medicine, the Shen is one of the vital substances of the body. It is the most subtle and non-material type of Qi. Most authors translate the word Shen as "spirit"; I prefer to translate Shen of the Heart as "Mind", where our emotions are translated into thoughts, into energy. This blend may assist with aiding and stabilising this largely mental process. It is recommended in case you are feeling irritable, frustrated or tense or in case of any kind of emotional imbalance. It contains lemon balm oil that Paracelsus (a Swiss physician, an alchemist and a philosopher of the German Renaissance) called the elixir of life. According to Hungarian folk traditions, lemon verbena and Roman chamomile have the strongest calming effects on a labile mind. They may reduce feelings of loneliness, assist you dealing with childhood traumas, and help you to rise up from the most difficult of situations, not unlike how the chamomile plant can straighten itself after being trampled upon.

Ritual · how to use

A) In case of emotional disharmony, everyday stresses: apply 6 drops on your Solar plexus (your energy centre above your belly button) + massage 2-2 drops into your temples + inhale the rest of the scent from your palms 5x deeply and rhythmically, mornings and evenings. In case of a long term therapy keep 2 days of break after 5 days of use. After 3 month of use, keep 1 week of break.

B) To ensure the quality of your sleep: massage 6 drops into the Solar plexus area + massage 6-6 drops into the inner part of your ankles + inhale the scent from your palms 5x deeply and rhythmically every evening. In case of a long term therapy keep 2 days of break after 5 days of use. After 3 month of use, keep 1 week of break.

C) In case of olfactory (inhalation) therapy to support your emotional and mental well-being: apply 2-2 drops on your wrists, rub them together and inhale the scents 7x deeply, rhythmically, 3 times per day. In case of a long term therapy keep 2 days of break after 5 days of use. After 3 month of use, keep 2 weeks of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Melissa officinalis (lemon balm), Pinus ponderosa (Ponderosa pine), Chamaemelum nobile (Roman chamomile), Origanum majorana (marjoram), Lavandula angustifolia (English lavender) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

I suggest you say out loud, 3x mornings & evenings, for 28 days, the following mantra: "I am connected with the energy of Mother Earth. I am connected to my body. I'm balanced, stable and grounded."

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight.

earth-prithvi.name: Earth · Prithvi
earth-prithvi.body:
The Earth element is that season of late summer, or between seasons, which is all about our connection. When we think of earth, we think of our groundedness, our presence to what is. In balance, Earth is content, grounded, present and connected, and it is the foundation for the other elements. It is nourished, both in body, soul and mind, and we are calm and loving, and free, feeling able to support others. Out of balance, we instead become needy. When we are out of touch with our ever-present connectedness, we drop into the Earth element emotion of worry.

This formula helps balance an excess or deficiency of the characteristics associated with the earth element: physical; material; form; structure; the ability to manifest an idea; practical sense; building; determined; holding on; grounded; anchored; stable; cautious; careful; conservative; steady; consistent; slow but sure; stubborn; obstinate; rigid; obsessed.

Useful for those who have one or more of the following characteristics: - cannot get projects from the idea stage into manifestation - need stability and consistency in their lives - are not grounded, tend to live with their heads in the clouds - need to cultivate a greater consciousness of their physical senses - need to be able to listen to their gut reactions - need determination and the ability to stick to a project or process - have difficulty completing things - don't want to change - are impatient and rigid - act rashly or too quickly - need to develop common sense

The Earth element, known in Sanskrit as "Prithvi" is the fifth and final great element. It is the final element because it evolves out of all five elements and contains the essence of all. Earth represents the densification of all matter until it becomes solid. Prithvi by its quality is stable, heavy, dry, dense, hard and tangible. When you are feeling ungrounded and unearthed you may feel flighty, chaotic or stuck in your head. According to Ayurveda, Prithvi Mahabhuta provides structural framework for each body parts. It is responsible to make the body strong and steady. Earth element is connected to the sense of smell.

Ritual · how to use

A) Add 8-12 drops into your diffuser in your home or during yoga/meditation classes and enjoy the energy of the earth in your space. Yoga teachers may offer 1 drop to their students at the beginning of the class (for meditation for example, before Pranayama practices) or right before Shavasana to inhale it a few times deeply. B) Add 1-2 drops into your palms, mornings and evenings, rub them together and inhale the scent from your hands 5x deeply and rhythmically. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break, after the break you can continue the journey the same way. C) Using it on specific body parts topically, like on the sole of the foot, tailbone (location of the 1st chakra) etc, please dilute 3 drops of Earth element formula with a small amount of base oil (for example: bio, cold pressed, virgin coconut oil, sunflower seed oil or almond oil) massage into the area mornings and evenings for 5 days. After 5 days of usage keep 2 days of break and continue with the same routine. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Vetiveria zizanoides (vetiver), Piper nigrum (black pepper seed), Pogostemon cablin (patchouli), Artemisia dracunculus (tarragon), Citrus paradisii zest (grapefruit peel) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Chanting Lam (lum), the bija mantra of the first chakra (root chakra), strengthens the earth element in the body and mind. This element relates to stability and solidity, so we would chant this to enhance these qualities in our body or life. Chant this mantra at least 7 times daily or 108 times for better result when feeling unsure, unsteady or insecure.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. Possible photosensitivity (where applied): avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours after application of the product.

water-jala.name: Water · Jala
water-jala.body:
The water element is related to our innate wisdom. When we were born we had an inner knowing, an intuition which guided us through life, that is still there in all of us, underneath our thinking that it isn't. We forget over time that we were born with this water energy, as we lose trust in the world and begin to fear things. The main destructive emotion of the water element is fear.

This formula helps balance an excess or deficiency of the characteristics associated with the water element: emotional; receptive; feelings; compassion; the unconscious or subconscious; intuitive; cleansing; dissolving; no shape of your own; communication through feelings; holding onto emotions; taking on feelings or emotions of others; strong ties with the past, confidence; self-awareness.

Useful for those who have one or more of the following characteristics: - fear their inner world - need to listen to their intuition - need to cultivate greater sensitivity to others - are uncomfortable with their feelings - hold onto their feelings, not allowing them to simply be felt and flow through - resent others and hold grudges - are depressed, possessive or moody - feel emotionally needy and clingy - are "psychic sponges" - withdraw into a private, fantasy world - have difficulty having emotional boundaries

The Water element, known in Sanskrit as "Jala", is the fourth great element and evolves from Ether or Space, Air and Fire because it contains all aspects of the other three elements. Jala represent fluidic matter and provide the body with basic nourishment, protection against dissolution, give motion and soothe pain and inflammation. It also acts as the driving force for the transportation of body fluids and nutrients in the body, as well as for the removal of body wastes just like sweat or urine out of the body. We as humans are made up of 70-75% water. It is the element that primarily protects our body and provides it with its most fundamental nourishment. Water is healing; it protects, nourishes, and binds the body together. By its qualities, water is cooling, hydrating, heavy, smooth, stagnant or inflow. It is the antidote to the symptoms that have the opposite of these qualities such as deep sensitivity, emotionally ungrounded, dehydrated, on-edge, low self-esteem or if your heart has become hardened.

Ritual · how to use

A) Add 8-12 drops into your diffuser in your home or during Yin yoga/meditation classes and enjoy the energy of the water in your space. Yoga teachers may offer 1 drop to their students at the beginning of the class (for meditation for example, before Pranayama practices) or right before Shavasana to inhale it a few times deeply. B) Add 1-2 drops into your palms, mornings and evenings, rub them together and inhale the scent from your hands 5x deeply and rhythmically. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break, after the break you can continue the journey the same way. C) Using it on specific body parts topically, like on the lower back/kidneys, lower belly area (location of the 2nd chakra) etc, please dilute 3 drops of Water element formula with a small amount of base oil (for example: bio, cold pressed, virgin coconut oil, sunflower seed oil or almond oil) massage into the area mornings and evenings for 5 days. After 5 days of usage keep 2 days of break and continue with the same routine. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Salvia sclarea (clary sage), Citrus limonum zest (lemon peel), Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Lavandula angustifolia (English lavender), Cupressus sempervirens (Mediterranean cypress) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

The mantra Vam (vum), the bija mantra of the second chakra (sacral chakra), strengthens the water element. This element relates to our ability to flow smoothly from one event to the next and to nourish others and ourselves. Chant this mantra at least 7 times daily or 108 times for better result when feeling harried, scattered, or in need of kindness and compassion.

Please read · cautions

Do not use during pregnancy and nursing. Possible skin sensitivity when applied without base oil (test it before usage by applying 1 drop onto the wrists to see how your skin reacts). Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Do not use internally. Phototoxic: skin (where applied) shouldn't be exposed to sunlight, solarium light and UV rays for at least 8 hours after application of the product.

fire-agni.name: Fire · Agni
fire-agni.body:
Ether provides fire the space to burn while air provides fire the capacity to burn. Hence, the third element is fire which evolves from ether and air. Just as the sun is the generator of energy for the earth, fire is the generator of energy for the body. Fire is the form of perception, light, and vision, so the eyes are considered to be the sense organ of fire. Fire represents light, heat, energy, metabolism, and the power of transformation. People with a strong fire element in their constitution have leadership qualities and are adventurous, brave, confident, motivated, energetic, and progressive. They are eager in pursuing goals and are full of youthful spirit.

This formula helps balance an excess or deficiency of the characteristics associated with the fire element: energy; action; transformation; enthusiasm; passion; will; motivation; conviction; the strength to survive; faith; open to direction from your higher power; knowing the source; spirit; burned out; intense; don't know when to stop.

Useful for those who have one or more of the following characteristics: - need to activate their will to take action - are so passionate that they "burn out" or tire those around them - need enthusiasm, passion and faith in their lives - are stuck in their lives or in a process and need to move on - dislike weakness in others, especially if it reflects their own weakness - are pessimistic and unmotivated - are afraid of transformation - need to find or express their individuality and their passion in life - demand too much of themselves and others - are too sharp or hotheaded - are demonstrative of emotion, but not necessarily with sensitivity

The Fire Element, known in Sanskrit as Agni, is essential for your health. Agni is the intelligent force of each cell, each tissue and every system within the physical body. When the digestive fire (Agni) is healthy, this impacts the positive wellbeing of the whole body. Metaphorically speaking, fire stands for intelligence, wit, clarity, truth, presence, and light. The element of fire lives in the physical body, keeping us "burning" and moving. This fire directs the release of hormones via the endocrine system and oversees the digestive, metabolic, and regulatory functions. Ayurveda identifies that Fire also resides in an even more subtle place: our minds. In our minds, fire provides clarity, illumination, and truth. This subtle aspect of fire is called Tejas in Ayurvedic philosophy, and it directs all mental, emotional, and spiritual activity, including the crucial mental actions of discernment and discipline. Fire is the element responsible for burning, clearing, cleansing, transforming and illuminating, but also for destruction, rage, power, impatience and recklessness.

Ritual · how to use

A) Add 8-12 drops into your diffuser in your home or during yoga/meditation classes and enjoy the energy of the fire in your space. Yoga teachers may offer 1 drop to their students at the beginning of the class (for meditation for example, before Pranayama practices) or right before Shavasana to inhale it a few times deeply. B) Add 1-2 drops into your palms, mornings and evenings, rub them together and inhale the scent from your hands 5x deeply and rhythmically. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break, after the break you can continue the journey the same way. C) Using it on specific body parts topically, for example the stomach area (location of the 3rd chakra) etc, please dilute 3 drops of Fire element formula with a small amount of base oil (for example: bio, cold pressed, virgin coconut oil, sunflower seed oil or almond oil) massage into the area mornings and evenings for 5 days. After 5 days of usage keep 2 days of break and continue with the same routine. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Citrus sinensis zest (sweet orange peel), Piper nigrum (black pepper seed), Elettaria cardamomum (cardamom seed), Citrus bergamia zest (bergamot peel), Eugenia caryophyllus (clove bud) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

The mantra Ram (rum) is the bija mantra of the third chakra (Solar plexus) and relates to the fire element. This element represents our ability to digest what is in front of us literally and figuratively, and the transformation of our work on ourselves. Chanting this mantra strengthens our work and encourages us to burn through any obstacles that have arisen. Chant this mantra at least 7 times daily or 108 times for better result.

Please read · cautions

Do not use during pregnancy and nursing and in case of high blood pressure. Causes skin sensitivity when applied without base oil (possibly less irritating without base oil by adding into the palms). Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Do not use internally. Phototoxic: skin (where applied) shouldn't be exposed to sunlight, solarium light and UV rays for at least 8 hours after application of the product.

air-vayu.name: Air · Vayu
air-vayu.body:
The Air element is often also described as 'Metal' in TCM, and it is all about taking in and letting go, the part of the cycle associated with grief, but also with the death of all that we think we are, and the reconnection to our true, grounded, connected nature. This element almost ties together all of the elements in a beautiful reminder that all we desire to be, we already are, but we forget this as we move through the cycles of life. The Air element is all about inspiration; about taking an expansive breath! In balance, we can inhale and exhale fully, in trust that the next breath will naturally come, just as life intended. We trust the process of grief, learning from each experience and gaining wisdom, trusting in life's flow. It is the season of Autumn; change. The imbalanced emotion of Air/Metal is grief, and lack of trust in letting go.

This formula helps balance an excess or deficiency of the characteristics associated with the air (metal) element: intellectual; thinking; logic; aesthetics; ideas; inspiration; original; creative; vision; detached; impersonal; objective; unlimited by form; infinite possibilities; the seed of a new form; flighty; ungrounded; nervous.

Useful for those who have one or more of the following characteristics: - are highly intellectual individuals who need a lot of mental stimulation - are ungrounded and tend to live from their minds - tend to believe that their mind's assessment of life is more important than their imagination, intuition, gut feelings, physical sensations, or instincts - need to increase their ability to plan and organize things - feel that intellectual pursuits are pretentious - need to get in touch with their creative and original thinking - need detachment and objectivity - are flighty and superficial - need to have more freedom or fear that their freedom is limited - are dealing with great amounts of information at the same time - obsess over situations or thoughts

The Air Element, known in Sanskrit as Vayu, not only means air as a mixture of nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide and other gases but also as a dimension of movement. It is the mobile part of the body. It is responsible for inhalation, exhalation, movements of different body fluids and movements of different body parts, for example opening and closing of the eye lids. Vayu Mahabhuta is connected to the sense of touch. Out of all of the 5 Ayurvedic Elements, Vayu is the most accessible and easiest element to gain some mastery of. Most yogic practices involve an element of breath work, called pranayama. Prana means life force in Sanskrit and is the most available to our existence every moment of the day. Without Air, we have no breath or ability to move through life. The impact of the air that we breathe is very immediate. Most people can't go without air for more than three-and-a-half to five minutes before causing serious damage or suffocation. The qualities of Air evoke movement, ease, lightness, speed but also unpredictability and flightiness.

Ritual · how to use

A) Add 8-12 drops into your diffuser in your home or during yoga/meditation classes and enjoy the energy of the air element in your space. Yoga teachers may offer 1 drop to their students at the beginning of the class (for meditation for example, before Pranayama practices) or right before Shavasana to inhale it a few times deeply. B) Add 1-2 drops into your palms, mornings and evenings, rub them together and inhale the scent from your hands 5x deeply and rhythmically. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break, after the break you can continue the journey the same way. C) Using it on specific body parts topically, like on the chest (location of the 4th chakra), please dilute 3 drops of Air element formula with a small amount of base oil (for example: bio, cold pressed, virgin coconut oil, sunflower seed oil or almond oil) massage into the area mornings and evenings for 5 days. After 5 days of usage keep 2 days of break and continue with the same routine. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Eucalyptus globulus (Tasmanian eucalyptus), Pinus sylvestris (Scots pine), Tsuga canadensis (Eastern hemlock), Melaleuca quinquenervia ct. cinéole (niaouli), Rosmarinus officinalis ct. camphre (rosemary) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

The bija mantra of the fourth chakra (heart chakra), Yam (yum), increases air element in the body and mind. This element is responsible for movement, quick changes, and inspiration. When you're feeling lethargic, apathetic or indifferent, chanting this mantra at least 7 times daily or 108 times for better result, may be the catalyst for the mental shift that is necessary to regain your perspective and enthusiasm.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. A skin test is recommended prior to use.

ether-akasha.name: Ether · Akasha
ether-akasha.body:
The Ether Element, known in Sanskrit as The Akasha Mahabhuta is considered to be the first and most subtle element. In Sanskrit, it translates to "all-enclosing, omnipresent or all-pervading." It permeates through the cosmos and is the omnipotent force for all life, sound, vibration and creation. It is the creative life force energy that gives drive and consciousness to existence. All the openings, passages, pathways and movements in our body are what correspond to the Akasha element. There is space within our ears so we can hear sound. There is space within our throat so we can swallow. There is space within our eyes so we can look at our environment. There is space between our joints so we can move, run, walk and dance. There is space within our hearts to keep the blood flowing. Akasha is more than just the absence of matter, it is the original form of existence to which everything, and everyone formed and to which everything, and everyone shall return to.

The element of spirit does not have the same arrangements of correspondences as the physical elements, since spirit is not physical. Various systems may associate planets, tools, and so forth to it, but such correspondences are far less standardized than those of the other four elements. The element of spirit goes by several names. The most common are spirit, ether or aether, and quintessence, which is Latin for "fifth element."

This formula helps balance an excess or deficiency of the characteristics associated with ether element: the quintessence; the pure and subtle essence of a substance; new beginnings; the energy state before physical manifestation; organic; organization; the ability to rise above chaos; the ability and desire to focus on the inner life.

Useful for those who have one or more of the following characteristics: - are morbidly intense - speak in a loud voice - are unable to let go of anger and resentment, or who fly into rage easily - experience panic and desperation - feel cut off from a Higher Power - are selfish - need to either create roots or pull up worthless ones - have control issues to heal - feel they are out of control - are overly controlling - are attached to their worldly desires

In Ayurveda, ether element, "Akasha" is responsible for making the body soft porous and light. Akasha Mahabhuta, the ether element is connected to the sense of hearing. All opening and spacious organs of the body are areas of the Akasha Mahabhuta, it provides space for the movement of different fluids and nutrients in the body.

Ritual · how to use

A) Add 8-12 drops into your diffuser in your home or during yoga/meditation classes and enjoy the ethereal space created by the Ether element formula. Yoga teachers may offer 1 drop to their students at the beginning or end of the class (for meditation for example, before Pranayama practices) or right before Shavasana to inhale it a few times deeply. B) Add 1-2 drops into your palms, mornings and evenings, rub them together and inhale the scent from your hands 5x deeply and rhythmically. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break, after the break you can continue the journey the same way. C) Using it on specific body parts topically, where you feel tense or blocked, please dilute 3 drops of Ether element formula with a small amount of base oil (for example: bio, cold pressed, virgin coconut oil, sunflower seed oil or almond oil) massage into the area mornings and evenings for 5 days. After 5 days of usage keep 2 days of break and continue with the same routine. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Cupressus sempervirens (Mediterranean cypress), Boswellia sacra (holy frankincense), Citrus aurantifolia zest (lime peel), Origanum majoranna (marjoram) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

The mantra Ham (hum), the bija mantra of the 5th chakra (throat chakra), strengthens the ether element. This element provides us the space to expand and flow endlessly. Chant this mantra at least 7 times daily or 108 times for better result when having difficulty communicating, being afraid to speak our truth or fearing our own thoughts and feelings.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight.
